scenes.heading: one script chats
scenes.narration: Can one script chat from a single graphics card? It stalls once its little training text runs out. You'd need steady text, a brain, and saved memory to keep chatting.

scenes.heading: hungry for text
scenes.narration: You still crave more text after one tiny file. For pretraining, the training scripts repeat the tuning loops for you. On demand, the token shards stream thousands of packed pieces.

scenes.heading: it forgets everything
scenes.narration: Your chat forgets everything without a lasting brain. The gpt transformer learns word patterns with fast focus math. The checkpoint store saves versioned weights so you resume anytime.

scenes.heading: you want replies
scenes.narration: You want answers, not just weights sitting on disk. The cli chat prompts you and prints sampled words back. That inference engine turns number sequences into replies with a small calculator.

scenes.heading: hello predicts world
scenes.narration: You stream the shards of climbmix, a big mix of text pieces, to study greetings. For learning, the training scripts train the transformer guesses until hello leads to world. Afterward they save the checkpoint weights to disk. When you start, the cli chat loads the checkpoint memory. It sends the tokens of your hello onward. Finally the inference engine runs the forward math and returns hello world to you.

scenes.heading: extra credit checks
scenes.narration: Helpers sit around your chat to build trust. Extra checks grade you on quizzes and code. The eval tasks score math, facts, and small programs for you.

scenes.heading: slow shared downloads
scenes.narration: The token shards hit downloads that are slow and shared when workers miss together. Caching them on fast disk fixes the stall. Then you train longer and still chat from memory.

scenes.heading: the big picture
scenes.narration: You streamed text to train a brain, saved memory, chatted for answers, then graded trust.
